# Parallax

> Parallax is a dashboard theme kit for shadcn-svelte (Svelte 5, Tailwind v4): a palette of
> 12 themes over one token set, four persisted appearance axes (inverted sidebar/header,
> floating header, auto-hide), an installable application shell, and a gallery of patterns.
> Distribution is a shadcn-svelte registry: source is copied into the consumer project.

## Registry items

Install with `npx shadcn-svelte@latest add <url>`. Post-install notes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/docs/REGISTRY.md

- [parallax-theme](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-theme.json): The Parallax palette: the base light and dark tokens, the seventeen alternate palettes behind `data-theme`, and the Tailwind mappings for the token families shadcn does not ship — success, warning, info, the subtle family, and `--sidebar-outline`.
- [parallax-appearance](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-appearance.json): The four appearance axes as persisted state: an inverted sidebar, an inverted header, a floating header and a header that hides on scroll down. Module-level runes that write attributes on `<html>`, plus the CSS those attributes key on.
- [parallax-appearance-controls](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-appearance-controls.json): The two dropdown menus that drive the axes: one for the sidebar (inverted, floating) and one for the header (inverted, floating, hide on scroll). Put them on a settings page — or back in the header bar through `PageHeader`'s `controls` snippet — and the axes become user-facing.
- [parallax-swap](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-swap.json): A two-state icon crossfade — the house primitive behind the light/dark toggle. Not in the official registry, which is why it ships from here.
- [parallax-shell](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-shell.json): The application shell: the sidebar (workspace switcher, two-shape navigation, user menu, icon rail, mobile drawer) and the page header bar (breadcrumb, search slot, light/dark toggle) — wired to the published appearance axes, taking their content as typed props.
- [parallax-skill](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-skill.json): The Agent Skill that teaches an AI assistant to use Parallax correctly: registry installation, shell composition, the token families, the palettes and the appearance axes, with the pitfalls spelled out. Installs into the project's `.claude/skills/parallax/`.
- [parallax-primitives](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-primitives.json): Shared infrastructure the house components compose: roving focus, form-control bridging, the TanStack table bridge, scroll position and the scroll parent, DOM-ordered collections. Installed automatically as a dependency; rarely asked for by name.
- [parallax-restyle](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-restyle.json): The Parallax shape for components this registry does not republish: css-only restyles of switch, checkbox, tooltip, inputs, native-select, select, sliders, sonner, navigation-menu, kbd, command and the tabs line variant, plus the global menu-shadow and dialog-scrim opinions. Install once beside parallax-theme.
- [parallax-accordion](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-accordion.json): The house accordion: shadcn's API with a chevron pair that swaps on open, hairline seams between items, and link and paragraph spacing inside a panel.
- [parallax-action-bar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-action-bar.json): The floating bulk-selection bar: a count, grouped actions, and an Escape that defers to open overlays.
- [parallax-alert](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-alert.json): The house alert: shadcn's API plus an `Alert.Action` corner slot and the full status ramp — the soft `*-subtle` family and the `solid-*` fills.
- [parallax-alert-dialog](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-alert-dialog.json): The house alert dialog: a `Media` part for the leading illustration, size variants on the content, and Action/Cancel that take Button's own `variant` and `size` rather than wrapping a button in a button.
- [parallax-angle-slider](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-angle-slider.json): A circular slider for angles: drag the thumb round the dial, with keyboard steps and an optional range. Reach for it when the value is a direction rather than a position on a line.
- [parallax-autocomplete](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-autocomplete.json): A text field that suggests as you type and still accepts what the list never offered — the free-text half of type-to-pick. Reach for Combobox instead when the answer must be one of the items.
- [parallax-avatar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-avatar.json): The house avatar: shadcn's API plus a size ramp, the hairline ring treatment, a status `Avatar.Badge` and `Avatar.Group` stacking.
- [parallax-badge](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-badge.json): The house badge: shadcn's API plus the soft `*-subtle` variants for every status family, and the ghost and link variants.
- [parallax-badge-overflow](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-badge-overflow.json): A row of badges that measures its container and folds whatever does not fit into a `+N` indicator. Reach for it wherever a list of tags has to survive a narrow column.
- [parallax-banner](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-banner.json): A full-width notification strip pinned to the top or bottom of the viewport, with a queue that shows one at a time in priority order. Reach for it when the message outranks the page — an Alert stays in the flow it was written into, and a toast clears itself.
- [parallax-breadcrumb](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-breadcrumb.json): The house breadcrumb: shadcn's API with the theme's separator rhythm and muted trail, sized for the header bar the shell renders it in.
- [parallax-button](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-button.json): The house button: shadcn's API on the --control-h-* ramp (24/32/40/48px), with xs/icon-xs sizes, the data-icon slots and the contextual solid and outline palettes.
- [parallax-button-group](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-button-group.json): The house button group: shadcn's API with the seam treatment that fuses a row or a column of controls into one shape, plus a `Text` part for inline labels.
- [parallax-calendar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-calendar.json): The house calendar: shadcn's API rebuilt on `--cell-size` and `--cell-radius`, so one month grid retunes for a card, a popover or a full page without forking the parts.
- [parallax-card](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-card.json): The house card: shadcn's API plus a `size` prop that retunes `--card-spacing`, and the ring-drawn outline.
- [parallax-carousel](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-carousel.json): The house carousel: shadcn's Embla wrapper with the previous and next controls rebuilt as round icon-sm Buttons on the house ramp.
- [parallax-chain-of-thought](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-chain-of-thought.json): The steps a model took to an answer, as a collapsible trace: labelled steps with a status each, search-result chips and an optional image. Reach for it to show the WORK; Timeline is for events that happened to a system.
- [parallax-chart](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-chart.json): The house chart frame: shadcn's LayerChart container, tooltip and legend on the theme's grid, axis and tooltip treatment, driven by a per-series colour config.
- [parallax-checkbox](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-checkbox.json): The house checkbox: shadcn's API on a 4px-radius box with the theme's border, focus ring and indeterminate mark.
- [parallax-checkbox-group](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-checkbox-group.json): Several checkboxes as one value: a shared label, description and validation message, horizontal or vertical. Reach for it when the boxes answer one question rather than several.
- [parallax-circular-progress](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-circular-progress.json): A progress ring: a closed circle, 48px on a 4px stroke, determinate or indeterminate. Reach for Gauge when the arc itself carries meaning — the two share their geometry.
- [parallax-code-block](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-code-block.json): A copyable — and, given a filename, downloadable — code sample with a line-number gutter, a language selector and lightweight language-aware highlighting. Reach for it for an opaque string to read and copy; JSON viewer parses a live value instead.
- [parallax-color-picker](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-color-picker.json): A full colour picker: a saturation and brightness area, hue and alpha sliders, the native eyedropper, and per-channel fields in hex, rgb, hsl or hsb.
- [parallax-color-swatch](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-color-swatch.json): A single colour chip that renders transparency honestly, in five sizes — the building block of the picker's palette rows and of any legend that names a colour.
- [parallax-combobox](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-combobox.json): A searchable select: a Command list inside a Popover, single, multiple, or multiple as chips. What it commits is always one of the items — reach for Autocomplete when the answer may be one the list never offered.
- [parallax-command](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-command.json): The house command menu: shadcn's cmdk wrapper with the input rebuilt on Input group, a rounded popover ground and the selected-row treatment the palette uses.
- [parallax-compare-slider](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-compare-slider.json): Two versions of one image and a divider that wipes between them, by pointer, by touch or from the keyboard.
- [parallax-confirmation](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-confirmation.json): The approval gate on a tool call: the request while a decision is open, then the accepted or rejected receipt, painted from the status ramp. Renders nothing until there is a decision to show.
- [parallax-context-menu](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-context-menu.json): The house context menu: shadcn's API with the flat row treatment, ring-drawn popovers and an RTL-aware submenu chevron.
- [parallax-context-usage](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-context-usage.json): How much of a model's context window a conversation has used — a ring in the composer, a hover card of token counts and, when the caller supplies one, the cost. Numbers and cost are the caller's; the component only formats them.
- [parallax-conversation](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-conversation.json): The transcript viewport: sticks to the bottom while a reply streams, offers a scroll-to-bottom button once the reader has scrolled away, an empty state, and a Markdown download of the whole exchange.
- [parallax-copy-button](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-copy-button.json): A button that writes text to the clipboard and swaps its icon for a tick — once the write has actually resolved. The swap is a Svelte transition, with no animation library.
- [parallax-cropper](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-cropper.json): An image and video crop surface: drag, wheel zoom, pinch-zoom-rotate and arrow-key nudging, rectangular or round.
- [parallax-data-grid](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-data-grid.json): The spreadsheet: virtualized rows, cell-addressed keyboard navigation, in-place editors per cell variant, its own ARIA grid markup.
- [parallax-data-table](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-data-table.json): The TanStack-driven table engine: createDataTable state in runes, Toolbar with meta-driven filters, ColumnHeader, FlexRender, Pagination. The motor behind every list page in the gallery.
- [parallax-date-selector](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-date-selector.json): One control for a day, a month, a quarter, a half-year or a year, behind an is/before/after/between operator, with a free-text input that parses all of them.
- [parallax-dialog](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-dialog.json): The house dialog: shadcn's API with the close control rebuilt as a ghost icon Button, on the popover ground the theme's overlays share.
- [parallax-direction-provider](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-direction-provider.json): The RTL/LTR provider. Where upstream renders no DOM and asks each consumer to forward `dir` itself, this renders a `display: contents` wrapper, so the real attribute reaches the subtree and descendants flip without opting in.
- [parallax-drawer](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-drawer.json): The house drawer: shadcn's Vaul wrapper on the popover ground, with the drag handle and edge treatment the mobile sidebar uses.
- [parallax-dropdown-menu](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-dropdown-menu.json): The house dropdown menu: shadcn's API with the flat row treatment, ring-drawn popovers and check and radio indicators on the trailing edge.
- [parallax-editable](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-editable.json): Text that becomes an input in place: a trigger, a preview, an input and a submit/cancel toolbar over one bindable value. Reach for it in a table cell or a heading where a whole form would be too much furniture.
- [parallax-empty](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-empty.json): The house empty state: shadcn's API with the media tile, heading and description treatment every placeholder in the gallery shares.
- [parallax-event-calendar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-event-calendar.json): A full scheduling surface: month, week, day, N-day, agenda and resource views over one event model, with time zones, recurrence, localisation and an imperative API.
- [parallax-field](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-field.json): The house field: shadcn's form-layout primitive carrying the label, description and error rhythm every form in this theme is built from, including the horizontal and fieldset arrangements.
- [parallax-filters](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-filters.json): The filter row as state: a filter is a chip of field, operator and value, and the row of them is a value the page owns. Reach for it when a list needs more than a search box.
- [parallax-fps](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-fps.json): A frames-per-second counter, for watching whether an interaction still runs at frame rate.
- [parallax-frame](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-frame.json): A presentational panel family: a bordered tray whose header, panels and footer share one spacing ladder and one radius, with panels separated, fused into a stacked run, or pulled flush to the edge.
- [parallax-gauge](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-gauge.json): A circular meter over a configurable arc — a dial, a segment, a sweep short of a full turn — with an indeterminate state. Reach for Circular progress when a closed ring is all you need.
- [parallax-hover-card](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-hover-card.json): The house hover card: shadcn's API on the theme's popover ground, ring-drawn rather than shadowed.
- [parallax-icon-stack](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-icon-stack.json): A layered isometric mark framing a single icon — the illustration an empty state or a feature card leads with, tinted from the surrounding text colour.
- [parallax-icon-tile](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-icon-tile.json): A small framed container for one icon — the mark that leads a list row, a feature card or an empty state — in five surfaces, five sizes and two corner treatments.
- [parallax-input](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-input.json): The house input: shadcn's API at the theme's height, padding and focus ring, so a field and a default button share a line.
- [parallax-input-group](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-input-group.json): The house input group: shadcn's API with addons on either side of the control or above and below it, and an `xs` button size for the controls that sit inside one.
- [parallax-input-otp](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-input-otp.json): A segmented one-time-code field, rebuilt on its own state module and provider: a slot per character, groups split by separators, and one hidden input so paste and autofill keep working.
- [parallax-item](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-item.json): The house item row: shadcn's title/description/action row with the `xs` and `sm` sizes and the media slot the gallery's list rows use. For the framed container drawn around a run of them, see the List group page.
- [parallax-json-viewer](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-json-viewer.json): A collapsible JSON tree coloured by runtime type, with expand and collapse, copy, and array truncation. Reach for Code block when the payload is an opaque sample rather than a tree to navigate.
- [parallax-kanban](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-kanban.json): A drag-and-drop board: reorder inside a column, move between columns, reorder the columns themselves — with a pointer, with touch, or from the keyboard alone.
- [parallax-kbd](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-kbd.json): The house keyboard key: shadcn's API as the theme's muted chip, sized to sit inside an input group or a menu row.
- [parallax-key-value](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-key-value.json): A dynamic list of key/value pairs with paste support and per-row validation — headers, environment variables, metadata a user types.
- [parallax-language-selector](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-language-selector.json): A dialog that switches the active locale. The catalog is data the caller supplies and the component moves a code: it translates nothing.
- [parallax-listbox](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-listbox.json): An always-visible option list with the WAI-ARIA keyboard model and typeahead, single or multiple, as a column or a grid. Reach for it when the options should not be hidden behind a trigger.
- [parallax-loader](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-loader.json): 128 loaders behind one API, with a shared reduced-motion answer: moving parts stop, the loader breathes.
- [parallax-marquee](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-marquee.json): Content that scrolls continuously, horizontally or vertically — pausing on hover and on focus, mirroring under RTL, and holding still for reduced motion.
- [parallax-mask-input](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-mask-input.json): An input that formats what you type against a pattern — a phone number, a date, a card, a currency amount — and keeps the caret where you left it.
- [parallax-masonry](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-masonry.json): A masonry grid: a column count that answers the breakpoint, and items placed by measured height rather than by row.
- [parallax-media-player](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-media-player.json): A full video and audio player: custom controls, chapters, captions, playback rate and the complete keyboard shortcut set.
- [parallax-mention](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-mention.json): A text field that suggests and inserts mentions when a trigger character is typed at a word boundary. The popup follows the caret, and each inserted mention behaves as one atomic unit of text.
- [parallax-menubar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-menubar.json): The house menubar: shadcn's API with the flat row treatment, ring-drawn popovers and indicators on the leading edge.
- [parallax-message](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-message.json): One turn of a chat — a user bubble or an assistant answer — with a Markdown response rendered through svelte-streamdown, actions, a toolbar, and a pager for walking the alternatives a regenerate leaves behind. Installing it brings svelte-streamdown and needs one `@source` line in the stylesheet.
- [parallax-model-selector](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-model-selector.json): A command palette for choosing a model: searchable groups per provider, provider logos, a name slot. Chosen values are the caller's; the component only presents the list.
- [parallax-native-select](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-native-select.json): The house native select: the browser's own dropdown at the theme's field height, with a `sm` or `default` size stamped as `data-size`.
- [parallax-navigation-menu](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-navigation-menu.json): The house navigation menu: shadcn's API with the theme's trigger, link and viewport treatment, and `navigationMenuTriggerStyle` exported for the links that are not triggers.
- [parallax-number-field](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-number-field.json): A numeric input with spinner buttons, press-and-hold repeat, keyboard stepping and a drag-to-scrub label.
- [parallax-pagination](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-pagination.json): The house pagination: shadcn's API with the page links drawn by `buttonVariants` at any Button size, so a pager matches the controls beside it.
- [parallax-partition-bar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-partition-bar.json): A total split into labelled parts: one bar per part, sized by its share, with its name and measurement underneath.
- [parallax-pending](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-pending.json): A wrapper that marks anything as pending: interactions off, keyboard focus kept, and the right ARIA state for buttons, forms, links and switches.
- [parallax-phone-input](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-phone-input.json): A phone field with country detection and international formatting, built on the mask input.
- [parallax-popover](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-popover.json): The house popover: shadcn's API plus `Header`, `Title` and `Description` parts, so a popover with a heading is composed rather than hand-laid.
- [parallax-progress](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-progress.json): The house progress bar: shadcn's API as a slim rounded track on the muted ground.
- [parallax-prompt-input](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-prompt-input.json): The composer: an auto-growing textarea that submits on Enter, a header and footer for tools, borderless selects, and a submit button that becomes a stop button while a reply is in flight. Files attach from its action menu, a drop or a paste, validated against `accept`, `maxFiles` and `maxFileSize`.
- [parallax-qr-code](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-qr-code.json): A QR code you compose: the same value rendered as SVG, canvas or image, with a centre overlay, a loading skeleton and a download control.
- [parallax-question](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-question.json): A clarifying question from the model, as a form: single or multiple choice, a free-text answer, and a submit that stays disabled until there is a response. Its shape is the AskUserQuestion tool call.
- [parallax-radio-group](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-radio-group.json): The house radio group: shadcn's API with the theme's ring, dot indicator and row rhythm.
- [parallax-range-calendar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-range-calendar.json): The house range calendar: shadcn's API plus the `rangeCalendar`, `rangeCalendarFlush` and `rangeDay` class recipes, so a range picker reads the same in a card, in a popover, or flush to a panel edge.
- [parallax-rating](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-rating.json): A star rating that displays whole, half and fractional scores, and — when editable — collects one by mouse or keyboard.
- [parallax-reasoning](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-reasoning.json): The model's reasoning summary in a collapsible panel that opens while it streams, reports how long the thinking took, and closes itself once the answer starts. Reach for it over Collapsible when the content is a thought, not a section.
- [parallax-relative-time-card](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-relative-time-card.json): A hover card that shows a moment as relative time, with the absolute time and its zone underneath.
- [parallax-resizable](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-resizable.json): The house resizable panes: shadcn's API with the hairline handle and grip the theme's split layouts use.
- [parallax-responsive-dialog](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-responsive-dialog.json): One dialog that renders as a centred modal above the breakpoint and a bottom drawer below it — and swaps between them without closing.
- [parallax-scroll-area](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-scroll-area.json): The house scroll area: shadcn's API with the overlay scrollbar the theme paints. Reach for Scroller instead when native scrolling should stay and only the edge cues are wanted.
- [parallax-scroll-spy](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-scroll-spy.json): Navigation links that track scroll position and scroll to their section on click, nested sections included.
- [parallax-scroller](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-scroller.json): A scroll container that keeps the browser's own scrollbar and fades the edges where content continues, with optional buttons that scroll on press, hover or click. Where Scroll area replaces the scrollbar, this only layers affordances on top of it.
- [parallax-segmented-input](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-segmented-input.json): Connected inputs that read as one segmented control, with focus and typing moving between the segments as they fill and empty.
- [parallax-select](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-select.json): The house select: shadcn's API at the theme's field height, with the boxed trigger, ring-drawn content and scroll buttons on the popover ground.
- [parallax-selection-toolbar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-selection-toolbar.json): A floating toolbar that appears over a text selection, carrying formatting and utility actions.
- [parallax-separator](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-separator.json): The house separator: shadcn's API on the theme's border token, a hairline in both orientations.
- [parallax-shake](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-shake.json): A wrapper that replays a perspective wobble whenever a signal changes — the wrong-password nudge.
- [parallax-sheet](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-sheet.json): The house sheet: shadcn's edge panel with the close control rebuilt as a ghost icon Button, and a `showCloseButton` for the panels that own their own.
- [parallax-sidebar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-sidebar.json): The sidebar primitive the application shell is built on — provider, rail, menu, sub-menu and mobile drawer — retuned to the theme's rhythm and its sidebar tokens. `parallax-shell` installs it already wired.
- [parallax-skeleton](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-skeleton.json): The house skeleton: shadcn's pulsing placeholder on the muted ground rather than the accent one.
- [parallax-slider](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-slider.json): The house slider: shadcn's API with the pale thumb and focus ring the theme's controls share, horizontal or vertical. Its name, description and value text reach the thumb — where the slider role lives — through `thumbLabel`, `aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby` and `thumbValueText`.
- [parallax-sortable](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-sortable.json): Drag-and-drop reordering for a list or a grid, operable with a pointer, with touch and from the keyboard alone. Kanban composes it.
- [parallax-speed-dial](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-speed-dial.json): A floating action button that fans a set of labelled actions out when it is triggered.
- [parallax-spinner](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-spinner.json): The house spinner: shadcn's loading mark with `role` and `aria-label` overridable, and the foreign icon-library props (`name`, `color`, `stroke`) normalised so another icon set can stand in.
- [parallax-status](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-status.json): A status indicator: a dot with an animated ping and the colour families, for system state, presence and service health.
- [parallax-status-monitor](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-status-monitor.json): The uptime strip from a public status page: one bar per period, coloured by state, with a tooltip per bar.
- [parallax-stepper](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-stepper.json): A multi-step flow with visible progress: a list of steps with indicator, title, description and separator, horizontal or vertical, each carrying its own state.
- [parallax-suggestion](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-suggestion.json): A row of follow-up prompts as pill buttons, scrolling sideways when they overflow. Each pill hands its text to the caller; reach for Badge when the chips are labels rather than actions.
- [parallax-switch](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-switch.json): The house switch: shadcn's API with the theme's track and thumb, stamped `data-size` so the control ramp reaches it.
- [parallax-table](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-table.json): The house table: shadcn's API plus the three-tier density axis (data-density retunes row/head/cell tokens; tiers are floors, not clamps).
- [parallax-tabs](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-tabs.json): The house tabs: shadcn's API plus the `line` list variant and its `sm` size, both stamped as `data-*` so `app.css` owns the look.
- [parallax-tags-input](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-tags-input.json): Free-text values entered as removable chips, with paste, split-on-delimiter, edit in place and per-tag validation.
- [parallax-task](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-task.json): A model's todo item as a collapsible: a title, sub-items and file chips, open by default so progress reads at a glance.
- [parallax-text-gradient](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-text-gradient.json): A highlight that sweeps through text — the label that says a machine is still working.
- [parallax-textarea](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-textarea.json): The house textarea: shadcn's API at the theme's padding and focus ring, so it matches the fields beside it.
- [parallax-timeline](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-timeline.json): A chronological list of events: vertical or horizontal, an alternating variant, RTL support, and completed/active/pending states.
- [parallax-toggle](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-toggle.json): The house toggle: shadcn's API on the --control-h-* ramp with the data-icon slots, so a toggle and a button share a line.
- [parallax-toggle-group](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-toggle-group.json): The house toggle group: shadcn's API with a `spacing` axis — fused into one shape, or spaced apart — and an orientation.
- [parallax-tool](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-tool.json): One tool call as a card: name, a status badge from the seven AI SDK states, the parameters it was called with and the result it returned — structured payloads through JSON viewer, text through code block.
- [parallax-tooltip](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-tooltip.json): The house tooltip: shadcn's API on the inverted foreground ground, with the arrow the theme draws.
- [parallax-tour](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-tour.json): A guided tour: highlight an element, step through the instructions, and teach a screen the first time somebody sees it.
- [parallax-tree](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-tree.json): A multi-level tree view with expand and collapse, selection, and the WAI-ARIA keyboard model.

## Guides

- [Registry guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/docs/REGISTRY.md): every item's post-install notes, wiring sample, first-paint script
- [Theme system](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/docs/THEME.md): the base palette, the OKLCH ladder, the token mapping, the audit
- [Conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/docs/CONVENTIONS.md): the house rules the source follows

- [Pattern recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/skills/parallax/references/patterns.md): distilled design recipes of the flagship gallery pages

## UI components

127 folders under src/lib/components/ui/:

accordion, action-bar, alert, alert-dialog, angle-slider, aspect-ratio, autocomplete, avatar, badge, badge-overflow, banner, breadcrumb, button, button-group, calendar, card, carousel, chain-of-thought, chart, checkbox, checkbox-group, circular-progress, code-block, collapsible, color-picker, color-swatch, combobox, command, compare-slider, confirmation, context-menu, context-usage, conversation, copy-button, cropper, data-grid, data-table, date-selector, dialog, direction-provider, drawer, dropdown-menu, editable, empty, event-calendar, field, filters, fps, frame, gauge, hover-card, icon-stack, icon-tile, input, input-group, input-otp, item, json-viewer, kanban, kbd, key-value, label, language-selector, listbox, loader, marquee, mask-input, masonry, media-player, mention, menubar, message, model-selector, native-select, navigation-menu, number-field, pagination, partition-bar, pending, phone-input, popover, progress, prompt-input, qr-code, question, radio-group, range-calendar, rating, reasoning, relative-time-card, resizable, responsive-dialog, scroll-area, scroll-spy, scroller, segmented-input, select, selection-toolbar, separator, shake, sheet, sidebar, skeleton, slider, sonner, sortable, speed-dial, spinner, status, status-monitor, stepper, suggestion, swap, switch, table, tabs, tags-input, task, text-gradient, textarea, timeline, toggle, toggle-group, tool, tooltip, tour, tree

Verbatim ports of official components install by their bare official name. Everything
Parallax-authored or Parallax-forked is a published parallax-<name> registry item — install
it from the registry rather than copying source; the gallery page listed above shows it in use.
